description: Current and previous-session spot prices for gold, silver, platinum, palladium, copper and nickel, in any supported currency and per troy ounce or gram.

base.description: A currency code from the live catalog at /api/currencies (ISO 4217 fiat plus BTC and the metal codes). Defaults to USD.

metals.description: Metal symbols to include (xau gold, xag silver, xpt platinum, xpd palladium, xcu copper, ni nickel). Omit for all six; Goldback is not a spot metal.

unit.description: Price per troy ounce or per gram. Defaults to troy_oz.
